reason: I already pay for Calm and I'm used to it, and on a student budget I'm not paying for a second sleep app on top. I might try the free 14 days since there's no auto-charge, but I sleep with earphones so the smart fade-out and auto-resume mostly don't apply to me, and I doubt I'd switch.
objection: With earphones in, I only get the button version, so it's not clear what this does better than the Calm timer I already pay for. I can't afford two subscriptions.
would_change_my_mind: If the 14-day comparison clearly showed I fell asleep faster, and it cost less than Calm so I could cancel Calm and replace it instead of adding another subscription.
